problem:
For a discrete random variable $Y,$ the probability mass function $f(y)$ and the cumulative distribution function $F(y)$ are shown in the table below. Fill in the blanks.

| $y$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ | $4$ | $5$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $f(y)$ | $0.10$ | $0.25$ | $0.30$ | $0.20$ | $0.15$ |
| $F(y)$ | $0.10$ | {{field-1}} | {{field-2}} | {{field-3}} | $1$ |
worked_solution:
The cumulative distribution function of a discrete random variable $Y$ is a function $F(y)$ such that

$$
F(y)=P(Y\le y).
$$

Computing $F(2),$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}F(2) & =P(Y\le 2) \\  & =P(Y\in {1,2}) \\  & =f(1)+f(2) \\  & =0.10+0.25 \\  & =0.35.\end{aligned}
$$

Computing $F(3),$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}F(3) & =P(Y\le 3) \\  & =P(Y\in {1,2,3}) \\  & =f(1)+f(2)+f(3) \\  & =0.10+0.25+0.30 \\  & =0.65.\end{aligned}
$$

Computing $F(4),$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}F(4) & =P(Y\le 4) \\  & =P(Y\in {1,2,3,4}) \\  & =f(1)+f(2)+f(3)+f(4) \\  & =0.10+0.25+0.30+0.20 \\  & =0.85.\end{aligned}
$$
